first.0: Mh..? Is that a name tag?
first.1: Quite a... uh... peculiar gift, colleague. I guess you really care about the fact that I don't remember my name.
first.2: I won't certainly start wearing a leash with this attached, but sure, call me whatever you want.

another.0: Another name tag? You have a unique way of telling me that you want to call me something else, colleague.
another.1: Sure, it makes no difference to me anyway.

nameTag.ricercatore: Uh, quite self-explanatory I must say. Maybe it's better if you actually come up with a proper personal name.
nameTag.researcher: Uh, quite self-explanatory I must say. Maybe it's better if you actually come up with a proper personal name.
nameTag.franco: Colleague, I know you may have put your heart into choosing this name, but I also have standards.
nameTag.folgo: Colleague, do I look like a bean to you?
nameTag.foldo: Colleague, do I look like a bean to you?
nameTag.synergo: I already heard about that expression in a distant land long ago, and I prefer not to use that name. Don't ask why, you wouldn't get it.

sabaku.0: Sabaku? Isn't there a language from a distant place in which it means "desert"? I recall some old fables where a certain 'Sabaku II' was a hero with a golden helmet, wandering through a dark world.
sabaku.1: The fable also spoke of his apprentice, but his name has been lost to time.
sabaku.2: Anyway, this name seems dear to you, colleague, but it doesn't belong to me, I'm sorry.

nameTag.lucio: The name of the old king? I don't want the name of someone who abandoned his people when they most needed him, Sorry, colleague.
nameTag.lionel: The name of the Ancient Archer? Colleague, perhaps you overestimated me, the effects of my aim are comparable to those of a landslide in the middle of a desert. Please, think of something else.

julius.0: The name of the Cursed Wolf? Colleague, as much as I like dogs, I'd prefer to avoid being called like the mastiff that used to slaughter the enemy legions.
julius.1: ...And in all this, I'm assuming you didn't expect me to start barking for you.

nameTag.nicolaos: The name of the Explosive Cube? Colleague, have I ever given the impression of wanting to blow up? I purposely scattered the surroundings with anti-Creeper excrements, no thank you.

wazo.0: The name of the first victim of the Night of the Diamond Swords? It was a terrible event, one of many from that war...
wazo.1: Forgive me, but I don't want a name that recalls such a tragic event.

efisio.0: The name of the Lava Eater? Colleague, I certainly don't share his fetish, nor his mastery in forging weapons, why should I use his name?
efisio.1: Unless this is a wish for me to end up roasted, I find it rather senseless.

ruslan.0: The name of the Builder of Everything, eh? I must say, I admired him a lot as a child, in my village we had a huge statue in his image.
ruslan.1: Surely it's thanks to him that civilization has remained intact to this day, although not as splendid as before. It's said that Ruslan went mad a long time ago, maybe he found something bigger than him?
ruslan.2: Oh, sorry colleague, I'm rambling. Anyway, I don't feel worthy of bearing such a name.

nameTag.grumm: Colleague, no. I know very well what that name tag does, and I don't want to suffer its effects, thank you.
nameTag.dinnerbone: Colleague, no. I know very well what that name tag does, and I don't want to suffer its effects, thank you.
nameTag.jeb_: Jeb_, huh? Sorry colleague, my lab coat doesn't have the ability to change color, if that's what you were hoping for. The name fits me, though.

toast.0: Oh, funny that you chose this name for me, it was the name of the bunny I had when I was little.
toast.1: Now that I think about it, it's strange that I remember his name but not mine, don't you think?
toast.2: I gladly accept it, in his honor...

johnny.0: Johnny? How strange, just the thought of being called that excites me, I feel like I can face any enemy, hostile or not!
johnny.1: I gladly accept it, this grit might save me in desperate situations.

manfredo.0: The name on this name tag... It's so... familiar...
manfredo.1: Manfredo, Manfredo... repeating it gives me a strange feeling... Could it be my old name? Damn, I can't remember...
manfredo.2: Oh, sorry, I was babbling to myself.
manfredo.3: I gladly accept it, I don't mind having it as a name.
